about: G00 (D6 §11.5, BUILD-PLAN R2): the vega-show report roles bound to the labels of the real CIC-IDS2017 report ($CIDS_ROOT/docs/main.aux, compiled from main.tex). golden/cic_authoring.py writes docs/label-roles.json (vega/label-roles@1) from it, with each label's number, page and title read from that .aux and its digest pinned. A role whose object the report does not carry is absent, never guessed: the report has no chapter on the bundle and no figure of its layout (chapter.pack, pack.layout), its data-lens findings are spread over three subsections with no one object to bind (chapter.lens), and its one pipeline figure is the capture's, not the chain's (intro.lane).
